summary: Rebuild Channels body as a mature source manager using Feedly Organize Sources as the primary prototype and Inoreader / Readwise Reader as secondary density references. Keep continuous source rows but use five desktop columns for channel, provider, kind, state and actions, with mobile collapse back to compact source rows. No fabricated metrics, no Shared Shell or Navigation changes, and no data model, schema, migration or updater changes. Production remains Owner manual.
